C1
Learned dynamics are accessible across control outputs.
已学习动力学可被多个控制输出利用。
E01–E03, E08: force-field and altered-arm-dynamics training transfer into another control response.
E01–E03、E08：力场与手臂动力学训练迁移至另一控制响应。
E04–E05: inconsistent exposure and mirror reversal dissociate outputs; E21 supplies a recurrent implementation. These counter the stronger claim of an obligatory single predictor.
E04–E05：不一致暴露及镜像反转使输出分离；E21提供循环实现。这些证据针对更强的“必然单一预测器”主张。
Transfer is assessed at specified response latencies, training durations and test contexts. Behavioural access does not locate a storage site.
迁移对应特定响应潜伏期、训练时长与测试情境。行为利用关系对存储位置保持开放。
Retain cross-output access; test acquisition against expression with crossed cues (R1).
保留跨输出利用结论；用交叉线索比较获得与表达（R1）。
C2
Sensory-specific learning and cross-output transfer can coexist.
感觉特异学习与跨输出迁移能够并存。
E17 already integrates sensory-specific memories; E28 establishes multiple timescales; transfer studies constrain the output axis.
E17已整合感觉特异记忆，E28确立多时间尺度；迁移研究约束输出轴。
The new fixed-readout mixed-state construction changes delay ratios and directly refutes ratio invariance as a general sharing test.
新增固定读出混合状态构造产生变化的延迟比例，直接反驳其作为普遍共享检验。
Constant ratios require effectively one-dimensional input trajectories. Common temporal modes can have separate neural copies.
比例恒定要求有效一维输入轨迹；共同时间模式可有分别神经副本。
Test joint temporal recurrences and held-out histories, retaining output-specific competitors (R6).
检验联合时间递推及留出历史，保留输出特异竞争模型（R6）。
C3
Error attribution influences component-specific learning.
误差归因影响成分特异学习。
E13–E16: source inference predicts generalization; revealing display distortion reduces selected aftereffects; imposed rotations exceed matched movement noise in adaptation.
E13–E16：来源推断预测泛化；揭示显示失真减小部分后效；外加旋转比匹配运动噪声产生更多适应。
E15 and E16 give opposite directions under the umbrella label external. E15 preserves proprioceptive recalibration.
E15与E16在笼统“外部”标签下方向相反；E15中本体重校准保留。
Display artifact, persistent environmental transformation and random motor noise occupy different causal categories; hand visibility changes input availability.
显示伪差、持续环境变换和随机运动噪声属于不同原因类别；手可见性改变输入可用性。
Compare defined causes while crossing persistence and calibrating perceived error; distinguish input, updating and expression (R1–R2).
比较明确原因，交叉持续性并校准感知误差；区分输入、更新和表达（R1–R2）。
C4
Reliability effects require a calibrated error-dependent component.
可靠性效应需要明确校准的误差依赖成分。
E18 links goal and visual gain to correction/learning; E12 and E15 demonstrate informative perceptual consequences.
E18连接目标、视觉增益与纠错/学习；E12及E15展示有信息量的感觉后果。
E24 reports error-independent changes under uncertainty. E25–E26 disagree with a purely physical visual-error definition.
E24报告不确定性下的误差无关变化；E25–E26挑战纯物理视觉误差定义。
Localization is a measurement of reported perception; its relation to the teaching error is a hypothesis requiring cross-task prediction.
定位测量的是报告感知；其与教学误差的关系需用跨任务预测检验。
Use zero and signed-error controls to separate intercept from slope, then propagate perceptual calibration uncertainty (R2).
用零误差和有符号误差对照分离截距与斜率，再传播感觉校准不确定性（R2）。
C5
Task error can change total adaptation through multiple routes.
任务误差可通过多条路径改变总体适应。
E22 reports task-error modulation of implicit recalibration; E23 establishes instruction-sensitive action selection.
E22报告任务误差调节隐式重校准；E23确立指示敏感动作选择。
E22 and E23 disagree over automatic modulation; E27 shows an attention manipulation can enhance adaptation, challenging a universal distraction-suppression explanation.
E22与E23对自动调节存在冲突；E27的注意操纵增强适应，挑战普遍的分心抑制解释。
Target movement, flicker, instruction, attention and reporting demands differ across protocols. Current evidence leaves a genuine empirical dispute.
目标运动、闪烁、指示、注意及报告要求跨方案不同；现有证据保留真实经验争议。
Compare task-error interaction and strategy-addition models under matched target events, aim reporting, attention controls and immediate aftereffects (R8).
在匹配目标事件、瞄准报告、注意对照及即时后效下比较任务误差交互与策略叠加模型（R8）。
C6
Correction–learning covariation constrains the teaching signal.
纠错—学习共变约束教学信号。
E06 relates EMG correction to temporally advanced next-trial learning.
E06将肌电纠错与时间提前的下一试次学习联系起来。
E07 varies error onset and reports stable learning timing with tonic-amplitude prediction; this challenges universal fixed waveform copying.
E07改变误差起点，报告学习时序稳定、持续响应幅度可预测学习，挑战普遍固定波形复制。
E06 uses force-field EMG; E07 is reviewed preprint v1 using visuomotor perturbations. Task differences prevent declaring a same-protocol refutation.
E06使用力场肌电；E07为视运动扰动已评审预印本v1。任务差异使两者构成跨任务边界比较。
Fit temporal copying and integration on one onset and predict a second onset plus sign reversal using whole waveforms (R3).
在一个起点拟合时间复制与整合模型，预测第二起点及符号反转的完整波形（R3）。
C7
Paired forces and muscle responses constrain neural and mechanical contributions.
配对力与肌肉响应约束神经和力学贡献。
E08 controls background activity; E09 separates dynamics compensation and impedance adaptation.
E08控制背景激活；E09分离动力学补偿与阻抗适应。
E09 demonstrates coexisting impedance changes; E10 shows sensory feedback changes gains. Either can alter an apparently matched trajectory.
E09显示共存阻抗变化；E10显示感觉反馈改变增益；两者均可改变表面匹配的轨迹。
Latency, posture, speed, probe compliance and co-contraction determine the interpretation of force differences.
潜伏期、姿势、速度、探针柔顺性及共收缩决定力差异的解释。
Add multidirectional mechanics and baseline EMG measurements before assigning residual changes to delayed control (R4).
增加多方向力学及基线肌电测量，再解释延迟控制的残余变化（R4）。
C8
Independent observation constraints can resolve specific factor contrasts.
独立观测约束能够解析特定因子对比。
Active/passive public data establish report-dependent changes; measured loadings can supply independent constraints.
公开主动/被动数据确立依赖报告的变化；实测载荷能够提供独立约束。
Update-sensitive reports exactly mimic input changes under the selective-report model. Common-mode dynamics admit separate copies.
更新敏感报告在选择性报告模型中精确伪装成输入变化；共同模式动力学允许分别副本。
Loading independence and cross-context transport must be measured. Cross-study motion data do not include these reports.
载荷独立性及跨情境迁移须测量；跨研究运动数据缺少这些报告。
Estimate the report model, propagate calibration uncertainty, then test frozen joint predictions; retain compatible factors when rank or recovery fails.
估计报告模型，传播校准不确定性，再检验冻结联合预测；秩或恢复不足时保留兼容因子。
